scope: Completion of the specified engineering requirements, not all-document accessibility certification. Each acceptance criterion maps to a verified delivery record and retained regression coverage.

requirements.requirement: Keep source operator indices exact when PDFBox dispatches virtual TD/TL operations.
requirements.acceptance: Mixed positioning/text fixture indices equal an independent PDFStreamParser token walk.

requirements.requirement: Treat single-quote and double-quote text showing as one source operation each.
requirements.acceptance: Quote operators decode complete text once and subsequent native tags own the correct glyphs.

requirements.requirement: Report Form XObject invocation paths separately from page text operators.
requirements.acceptance: Nested/reused Forms carry stable invocation identities; no child operator impersonates page text.

requirements.requirement: Tag text in nested and reused Form XObjects with invocation-specific ownership.
requirements.acceptance: Saved text in two differently transformed invocations has correct owners and unchanged pixels.

requirements.requirement: Write stream references and scoped ParentTree entries for non-page content.
requirements.acceptance: Identical MCID numbers in different streams resolve to their own structure elements.

requirements.requirement: Attach a marker-only source operator to Lbl and following content to LBody.
requirements.acceptance: Separate marker/body operands yield nonempty saved Lbl and LBody without moving glyphs.

requirements.requirement: Split qualified TJ list markers while retaining all positioning adjustments.
requirements.acceptance: Mixed string/number TJ arrays preserve advances, bytes and distinct label/body ownership.

requirements.requirement: Partition one source text operation across multiple intended label/value nodes.
requirements.acceptance: Booklet label/value examples attach to exact intended nodes; spacing and geometry are unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Expose verified byte boundaries for multibyte codes, ligatures and Unicode sequences.
requirements.acceptance: Splitting never bisects a font code or Unicode mapping; ambiguous boundaries are rejected.

requirements.requirement: Retain optional-content wrappers during retagging.
requirements.acceptance: Default visibility and alternate layer states render identically; generated MCIDs remain balanced.

requirements.requirement: Carry valid source ActualText/expansion semantics through native rebuilding.
requirements.acceptance: Authored ligature and abbreviation replacement survives without duplicating or suppressing unrelated text.

requirements.requirement: Retain evidenced pagination/background artifact properties without hiding meaningful content.
requirements.acceptance: Saved pagination/artifact metadata survives, while identically styled body text remains semantic.

requirements.requirement: Normalize extraction, matching and saved geometry for nonzero/negative crop origins.
requirements.acceptance: Shifted-crop fixtures attach all intended text and retain page geometry and pixels.

requirements.requirement: Use a consistent coordinate convention for PDFs with non-default UserUnit.
requirements.acceptance: Scaled-unit fixtures preserve coordinates across text, annotations and matching without double scaling.

requirements.requirement: Order semantic content in the actual display frame across page rotations.
requirements.acceptance: Rotated multicolumn pages have expected saved order at 0/90/180/270 degrees.

requirements.requirement: Prevent paragraph merging across adjacent label/value columns.
requirements.acceptance: Booklet launch details and acronym rows retain distinct identities and logical pair order.

requirements.requirement: Distinguish repeated headers/footers from repeated meaningful body text.
requirements.acceptance: Location-varying pagination is recognized; body repetitions and section titles are retained.

requirements.requirement: Separate section numbering from decimals, dates and numbered list items.
requirements.acceptance: Adversarial numeric examples keep their correct roles while evidenced numbered headings remain headings.

requirements.requirement: Improve heading continuation across mixed fonts and adjacent subtitles.
requirements.acceptance: A heading wraps completely without swallowing a differently ranked subtitle or body line.

requirements.requirement: Keep section containers consistent with corrected heading ranks and membership.
requirements.acceptance: Saved nested sections agree with the approved outline after heading demotion and rank refinement.

requirements.requirement: Verify that every saved MCR points to a real marked-content sequence.
requirements.acceptance: Deleting or changing a sequence makes saved comparison fail, even when its MCR dictionary remains.

requirements.requirement: Require meaningful owned content rather than an empty MCID wrapper.
requirements.acceptance: Empty and whitespace-only wrappers cannot satisfy intended nonempty text attachment.

requirements.requirement: Detect duplicate and foreign ownership of painted source content.
requirements.acceptance: Wrong-owner and multiply-owned glyph mutations fail despite unchanged structure IDs.

requirements.requirement: Verify reciprocal ownership across page, Form and annotation scopes.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-stream and annotation-key mutations fail; valid reused MCIDs in separate scopes pass.

requirements.requirement: Compare intended source identities against the actual saved glyph coverage.
requirements.acceptance: Partial substring matches cannot pass complete text; bounded replacement-text exceptions carry proof.

requirements.requirement: Map OCR coordinates through crop, rotation and render scale exactly once.
requirements.acceptance: Known image text boxes land correctly on rotated/cropped pages at multiple render resolutions.

requirements.requirement: Insert a tagged invisible text layer for accepted OCR on image-only pages.
requirements.acceptance: Official poster and synthetic scans expose saved text with complete ownership and unchanged images.

requirements.requirement: Attach OCR-only regions without duplicating native text or losing conflicts.
requirements.acceptance: Booklet mixed page gains OCR attachments; overlapping native/OCR conflicts remain explicit review tasks.

requirements.requirement: Embed verified OCR fonts and preserve Unicode for characters outside the first font.
requirements.acceptance: Accents, symbols and missing-glyph cases have correct extracted text or explicit failure, never replacement boxes.

requirements.requirement: Carry word-level uncertainty and corrections through to saved output qualification.
requirements.acceptance: Low-confidence text cannot be silently accepted; hash-bound corrections change only intended text metadata/layer.

requirements.requirement: Qualify missing mappings using the existing embedded TrueType program.
requirements.acceptance: Booklet mapping failures reduce only with proven used-code/GID equivalence and pixel preservation.

requirements.requirement: Repair supported symbolic-font Unicode mappings using verified glyph evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Wingdings-like cases produce correct Unicode for observed glyphs; unsupported ambiguity stays unresolved.

requirements.requirement: Recover missing programs only from verified matching donor programs and metrics.
requirements.acceptance: Exact-donor fixtures embed correctly; similar-family substitutions and mismatched advances are refused.

requirements.requirement: Distinguish absent, malformed and contradictory mappings with bounded repair.
requirements.acceptance: Malformed maps are diagnosed per used code; verified replacements preserve glyph selection and extraction.

requirements.requirement: Extend form-default font qualification to new input and non-ASCII supported glyphs.
requirements.acceptance: Fill/save/reopen retains field values and appearance for verified repertoire; unsupported glyphs are reported.

requirements.requirement: Bind native Link tags, annotation OBJRs and ParentTree entries to source anchor text.
requirements.acceptance: New native output has reciprocal link ownership with unchanged action, rectangle and appearance.

requirements.requirement: Associate rotated and multiline link geometry in a consistent coordinate frame.
requirements.acceptance: QuadPoints/rotation fixtures bind the correct anchor and preserve actions; nearby text is excluded.

requirements.requirement: Group multiple anchor text runs under one appropriate Link structure element.
requirements.acceptance: Wrapped anchors retain ordered text and one annotation reference without stealing neighboring runs.

requirements.requirement: Create hierarchical bookmarks from an accepted document outline.
requirements.acceptance: Unicode titles, page targets and hierarchy round-trip correctly; existing authored bookmarks are preserved.

requirements.requirement: Include page labels and outline destinations in saved preservation qualification.
requirements.acceptance: Mutated Roman/decimal labels or bookmark destinations fail preservation; unchanged labels pass.

requirements.requirement: Detect and resolve inconsistent row/column spans before inventing grid positions.
requirements.acceptance: Overlapping spans generate a bounded repair/review result; valid merged grids serialize unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Improve corner and multirow header association with explicit scope evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed mixed-header fixtures expose correct Headers relations with no unrelated header targets.

requirements.requirement: Keep repeated header occurrences and continuation references scoped correctly.
requirements.acceptance: A continued table retains all page header occurrences and associates each body cell with the correct headers.

requirements.requirement: Prevent diagram label alignments from becoming false tables.
requirements.acceptance: Booklet diagrams and negative fixtures retain meaningful figure/text grouping; genuine aligned tables still work.

requirements.requirement: Save evidence-backed Table/Figure caption relationships in correct reading order.
requirements.acceptance: Caption association survives output and does not attach neighboring unrelated prose.

requirements.requirement: Attach every native form widget to the intended Form structure without rebuilding controls.
requirements.acceptance: Multiwidget fields have reciprocal OBJRs and unchanged names, values, actions and appearance streams.

requirements.requirement: Apply accepted missing-name associations through a hash-bound qualified repair.
requirements.acceptance: Only reviewed missing TU names change; existing names and form behavior remain intact.

requirements.requirement: Preserve group identity while exposing distinct choice labels and export states.
requirements.acceptance: Radio groups expose reviewed names/choices and still select, save and reopen correctly.

requirements.requirement: Qualify structure-based form navigation across multiline, repeated and hidden widgets.
requirements.acceptance: All eligible widgets occur once in expected order; hidden widgets and noninteractive labels are handled explicitly.

requirements.requirement: Integrate source coverage, semantic failures and preservation into final candidate eligibility.
requirements.acceptance: Stale, partial or failed evidence cannot publish a qualified result; complete machine evidence still requires human review.

limitations: Engineering scope completion does not mean all PDFs are fully accessible or all corpus failures are resolved. Human semantic, visual, reader and interactive-form review remains mandatory.
Production checks remain opt-in; standalone validator and preservation reports retain their existing advisory behavior. Prior reports need a fresh completion report before gated download.

Preserved mode requires unchanged reference structure/content and source byte prefix. Reviewed transformations that change that reference need separate qualification; this gate grants no new repair waiver.
Native rendering verifies current VIEW/PRINT states at 120 DPI. Optional-content states, encryption, signatures, XFA, exceeded limits and unavailable evidence remain unqualified.
Only supported embedded TrueType maps have bounded semantic-equivalence normalization. Other protected font metadata, including Type1 Unicode maps, is compared exactly.
Source coverage counts inspected text/image occurrences; vector semantics, authored artifact correctness, image meaning and OCR transcription require human review.
No Java or repository-wide coverage percentage is claimed. Historical corpus failures remain documented in their delivery records.
